description: This file provides utility functions for handling hexadecimal and byte array conversions, including methods to convert bytes and byte arrays to hex strings, parse hex strings into byte arrays, and convert between integers and hex strings. It is a utility class likely used by other parts of the project to handle hex-related data processing.

classes.name: HexUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for converting between bytes, hex strings, and integers, facilitating hexadecimal data handling within the project.

methods.name: asHex(byte b)
methods.description: Converts a single byte to its uppercase hex string representation.

methods.name: asHex(byte[] in)
methods.description: Converts a byte array to an uppercase hex string.

methods.name: asBytes(String hex)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into a byte array, removing spaces and optional '0x' prefix.

methods.name: bytesToHex(byte[] bs, int off, int length)
methods.description: Converts a segment of a byte array into a hex string.

methods.name: bytesToHexAppend(byte[] bs, int off, int length, StringBuffer sb)
methods.description: Appends the hex representation of a byte array segment to a StringBuffer.

methods.name: bytesToHex(byte[] bs)
methods.description: Converts an entire byte array to a hex string.

methods.name: hexToBytes(String s)
methods.description: Converts a hex string into a byte array.

methods.name: hexToBytes(String s, int off)
methods.description: Converts a hex string into a byte array starting at a specified offset.

methods.name: hexToBytes(String s, byte[] out, int off)
methods.description: Converts a hex string into a provided byte array starting at a specified offset.

methods.name: hexToInt(String input)
methods.description: Converts a hex string (with optional '0x' prefix) to an integer.

methods.name: intToHexString(int input)
methods.description: Converts an integer to its uppercase hex string prefixed with '0x'.
